## What is Bitcoin (BTC)?

Bitcoin, represented by the ticker BTC, is the first decentralized cryptocurrency and top cryptocurrency by market capitalization. Launched in 2009 by the pseudonymous creator Satoshi Nakamoto, Bitcoin allows users to transfer value through a peer-to-peer network without relying on a central bank or payment intermediary.
